about: judge_rubric grader (spec 5.5). Judge requests are providers.CompletionRequest values (field names Model/System/Prompt/Temperature/MaxTokens/Settings). Error strings are exact Go output except '{SPEC_SCHEMA_URL}' / '{TASK_SCHEMA_URL}', which Go renders as 'file://<process cwd>/spec.schema.json#' (cwd-dependent, see QUIRK in behavior doc). Text after the 'jsonschema validation failed with' marker is santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema v6 library wording; parity requirement is the prefix up to and including '<kind> spec: ' plus the pass/fail decision, and 'contains' checks named in go_test_expect.
system_prompt_exact: You are an impartial grading judge. Score the output under evaluation against each rubric dimension on a scale from 0.0 to 1.0, anchoring your judgment to the reference material when it is provided. Respond with only a JSON object of the form {"scores": {"<dimension>": <number>}} covering every rubric dimension exactly once. No prose, no markdown.

position_biased_judge: test double used by judgerubric.TestGolden: it cuts the request prompt at the first '--- response format ---', finds every match of regex "([a-z][a-z0-9_]*)": <0\.0-1\.0> in order, and scores match i as 1.0 - 0.4*i (so 1.0, 0.6, ...), replying json.Marshal({"scores": {...}}).
